protocol.origin: First anchored Tree MIQP output in the published 30-second random comparison
protocol.observations: Same eight-day metered P, Q, Y and root squared voltage; identical hard anchors
protocol.selection: At most one change from the common original tree; also compare addition-or-exchange on common base
protocol.cohorts: The four diagnostic cases were chosen from retrospective structural checks. All 21 including the other seventeen are development feeders.
protocol.timing: Single-thread BLAS and Gurobi. Matched arms take completed position returns in their original order up to the shorter cumulative position-compute time, excluding shared initialization; no interim result is credited for an unfinished position.
protocol.stopping: Per-position enlargement applies when its valid bound still allows a better exchange. A missed best-group certificate is relative to a restricted add or exchange domain.
protocol.evaluation: Truth read for reporting after all arms have selected; an independent explicit BVLS refit verifies every returned tree
